<function name="GetFogDistances" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the fog start and end distance.</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Fog start distance set by <page>render.FogStart</page>.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">For end distance set by <page>render.FogEnd</page>.</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">Fog Z distance set by <page>render.SetFogZ</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
